Q: Getting error 13: permission denied while trying to save my jupyter notebook A:

I found a way to fix this but this answer might only be appropriate for my situation.

So, the reason for the problem is that I first installed Jupyter notebook using pip and later on I installed it using anaconda because if I recall correctly I couldn't properly configure the installed using pip due to which I used conda. So below is how I fixed the problem.

First I uninstalled conda. By using these cmds

    rm -rf ~/anaconda3
    rm -rf ~/.condarc ~/.conda ~/.continuum

and edited ~/.bachrc to remove Anaconda directory from the PATH environment variable by deleting

    # added by Anaconda3 installer
    export PATH="/home/linuxize/anaconda3/bin:$PATH"

I used all these cmd in terminal

    pip3 uninstall jupyter
    pip3 uninstall jupyter_core
    pip3 uninstall jupyter-client
    pip3 uninstall jupyter-console
    pip3 uninstall notebook
    pip3 uninstall qtconsole
    pip3 uninstall nbconvert
    pip3 uninstall nbformat

Then I went to /usr/local/lib/python3.8/dist-packages and deleted all the directories which were of jupyter, notebook, etc and then deleted python files related to jupyter in pycache directory.

Then I finally reinstalled anaconda. I'm not sure which steps were or weren't necessary but this fixed my problem.

Q: Session table name missing from CodeIgniter core query when $config['sess_driver'] = 'database' and $config['sess_save_path'] = null A:

The docblock in application/config explains:

| 'sess_save_path'
|
|   The location to save sessions to, driver dependent.
|
|   For the 'files' driver, it's a path to a writable directory.
|   WARNING: Only absolute paths are supported!
|
|   For the 'database' driver, it's a table name.
|   Please read up the manual for the format with other session drivers.
|
|   IMPORTANT: You are REQUIRED to set a valid save path!

Because your $config array contains:

$config['sess_driver'] = 'database';

You must declare:

$config['sess_save_path'] = 'your_session_database_table_name';

If the sess_save_path element is not set, I expect that a "debug" message will be logged to warn you of the problem.

The constructor method of CI_Session_database_driver (system/libraries/Session/drivers) implements this:

// Note: BC work-around for the old 'sess_table_name' setting, should be removed in the future.
if ( ! isset($this->_config['save_path']) && ($this->_config['save_path'] = config_item('sess_table_name')))
{
    log_message('debug', 'Session: "sess_save_path" is empty; using BC fallback to "sess_table_name".');
}

Q: PhilSMS API sends a voice call instead of plain SMS despite setting `type` to `plain` A:

The Laravel request is fine. If the request body reaching PhilSMS is actually:

{
    "type": "plain"
}

and the API returns 200, but the recipient still gets a voice call, the conversion is happening on the PhilSMS side, not in Laravel.

The first thing to check is the PhilSMS account/sender configuration. In particular, verify that the sender ID/API route is enabled for SMS and that there is no account-level voice/call fallback configured.

You can confirm this by sending the same request with a minimal cURL/Postman request. If that also results in a voice call, your application is ruled out.

Also make sure you're using the exact endpoint for your PhilSMS account:

https://dashboard.philsms.com/api/v3/sms/send

So there is no Laravel/config-cache fix required here. If type=plain is present in the actual HTTP payload, PhilSMS support needs to check the account/sender/API configuration on their side.

Q: Observer fails to start with ret=-4147: __min_full_resource_pool_memory out of range A:

The problem is the __min_full_resource_pool_memory value, not memory_limit.

For a mini/single-node CE deployment, 268435456 (256 MiB) is below the minimum allowed value. Set it to at least 512 MiB:

__min_full_resource_pool_memory: 536870912

For example:

memory_limit: 4G
system_memory: 2G
__min_full_resource_pool_memory: 512M
datafile_size: 8G

Then recreate/redeploy the cluster so OBD passes the updated value to observer.

The -4147 here is OB_INVALID_CONFIG; observer rejects the startup config because __min_full_resource_pool_memory=256M is outside the valid range. Increasing it to 512M fixes the startup failure for the mini deployment.

Q: XAMPP 8.2.4 install fails with "Error copying file" on Ubuntu (new release, PHP 8.5 native) — missing .so symlinks and config files A:

XAMPP 8.2.4 is not fully compatible with the newer Ubuntu releases that ship PHP 8.5.

The installer can finish partially, leaving missing .so symlinks and files such as httpd.conf, proftpd.conf, and the expected lampp script. Recreating those files/symlinks manually is not a reliable fix because the XAMPP bundle itself is built for an older Ubuntu/glibc environment.

The practical fix is to either:

  • Install XAMPP on an older supported Ubuntu version/VM, or

  • Use Ubuntu's native Apache + PHP + MariaDB/MySQL instead of XAMPP.

So if you're on a very recent Ubuntu release, I would not use XAMPP 8.2.4. Switching to a newer XAMPP build (if available for your Ubuntu environment) or using the native LAMP stack is the safer solution.
